reviewSamples.author: Victoria
reviewSamples.text: Wow, what an amazing massage. I feel so relaxed, distressed, and calmer. Not only did I get one of the best massages ever, but I also learned a lot too on how to better my lifestyle with certain movements and meditation. It is worth it!!

reviewSamples.author: Bianca Maffei
reviewSamples.text: Amazing! Removed all my built up tension! Bonus points, easy and free parking!! Will be coming back soon.

reviewSamples.author: Grethel Silva
reviewSamples.text: Claudia, your massages are amazing! Total relaxation... I look forward to my next massage. It helped me sleep 7 hours straight, something I hadn't done in a long time. Thank you!!!

reviewSamples.author: Chris Costantini
reviewSamples.text: One of the best massages I've ever had. Claudia has great energy and is truly a professional. I would highly recommend calling her!!

reviews_excluded_note: A 5th sample from Mariela Rojas contained an em-dash in the verbatim Google text; skipped in favor of 4 other real reviews that already satisfy the 3-5 quote requirement without editing any quoted text.
